rows.50:0e30:
...Do you feel even the slightest bit sorry?
I suppose a person like you never feels sorry for anything.
You probably intend to spend your whole life cracking jokes.
...That's fine, I suppose.
It's your life, after all.
However, please do not drag me into it.
If you drag me into it, I will not hesitate to resort to retaliatory measures.
...Well then, let us begin.
Thanks to what you just did, Kazama, I have to change the story I prepared.
You see, the angry spirits must be appeased.
...Allow me to turn off the lights.{p}
rows.50:1830: I want to watch a little longer
rows.50:1ac0:
"...I see.
You really are a complete idiot.
So you're telling me you can't understand how you've troubled me unless I go out of my way to spell it out?"
Arai {f:was|was} relentlessly spoiling for a fight.{p}
rows.50:2958:
Thank you all for your cooperation.
Let me explain why I turned off the lights.
There's no need to be afraid.
At any rate, the spirit is in an extremely dangerous state right now.
...Strictly speaking, I wonder whether we can even call it a spirit.
I have my doubts about that myself.
It is not so much a spirit as a 'something' that is here.
It seems the people gathered here have a strong sixth sense.
All except one...
So I imagine you can all feel it too.
The presence of that something.
And that it is angry, too.
I turned off the lights so that the something would calm down, even a little.
Because if that presence is in a dangerous state, then we are in a very dangerous position ourselves.
From now on, please do exactly as I say.
If you do, we should somehow be able to escape the danger.{p}Is that understood?
rows.50:61fc:
"You want to get hit that badly?
Don't tell me you've got some weird tastes after all.
But I'm a gentleman, you see.
I'll be glad to grant your request."
He clenched his fist tight.
Seen like this, he actually looked the part.
Maybe Kazama was actually incredibly tough in a fight.{p}Should I stop them before it turns into a fistfight{f:?|?}
rows.50:7e50:
"Excuse me, you're all members of the seven wonders project, aren't you?"
Arai was standing behind us, though none of us had noticed him arrive.
"I'm very sorry.
Something came up, so I'm late."
"………………"{p}
rows.50:7ef0: The seven wonders project was cancelled.{p}
rows.50:8460:
Arai went flying and hit his head on a shelf.
He slid limply to the floor.
{f:Oh no|No...}!
{f:I|I} panicked.
After hitting it that hard, he had to be hurt{f:.|.}
{f:My|My} conscience stung a little for not stopping them before it came to this.
I ran over to Arai.
"Are you all right, Arai?"
I took his limp hand.{p}
